description: For lawn care, this inspection checklist records mowing height, edging, trimming, debris, treatment exclusions, seasonal needs, frequency, and pricing. Its supporting evidence includes arrival condition, measurements, route photos, weather, completed services, product record, and damage observations.

blocks.guidance: Link this lawn care review to the service record.

blocks.label: Lawn Care Context

sections.guidance: Identify the lawn care service, reviewed areas, crew, and customer.
sections.title: Service Visit Reference

blocks.guidance: Mark each lawn care item after direct review.
items: Mowing height and pattern match the property instruction
Edges, beds, sidewalks, and drive areas are clean
Gates, irrigation heads, ornaments, and obstacles are undamaged
Skipped or saturated turf zones have a recorded reason
Approved seasonal tasks and add-ons are reconciled
Clippings, equipment marks, photos, and property security are checked
blocks.label: Lawn Care Task and Area Checks

blocks.guidance: Use one lawn care row for each reviewed area.

subtitle: Lawn Care Inspection Checklist: lawn service assessment and route completion using property boundaries, mowing height, and arrival condition.
title: Lawn Care Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during lawn service assessment and route completion when the lawn care record must identify property boundaries, turf zones, beds, trees, irrigation, gates, pets, slopes, and parked assets. Complete the applicable handoff for service verification, gate closure, customer note, skipped-area reason, next-visit plan, and route closeout.
